dedupe_keys.name: air traffic assignment to reduce population noise exposure using activity based approach belgrade nikola tesla airport case study

description: Air traffic assignment to reduce population noise exposure using activity-based approach (Belgrade Nikola Tesla airport case study) provides supporting airport-route assignment data for a mathematical model and heuristic that reduce population noise exposure. The provider is Ganić, Emir; Babić, Obrad. Geographical and temporal coverage: The study concerns Belgrade Nikola Tesla airport and accounts for spatial and temporal variation in nearby population. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
